known_fixes: Existing root Dockerfile copies a prebuilt build/ that is not in the repo — wrote Dockerfile.codepress that runs `yarn build` inside the image instead.
Pinned node:16-bullseye-slim — the legacy webpack 3 / babel 6 toolchain needs OpenSSL 1.1.1 (newer Node throws ERR_OSSL_EVP_UNSUPPORTED during the build).

The build context filter strips every directory named node_modules at any depth, so the app's src/node_modules component source never arrives via COPY — the Dockerfile reconstructs it from lib/ (the committed babel-compiled mirror, identical file tree) before `yarn build`.
discovery_notes: Create React App demo (webpack 3 / babel 6, React 16) for the react-dotdotdotloader npm package. An Express server (server/index.js) serves the production build/ output on port 3000. The loader component lives under src/node_modules (legacy CRA module-resolution pattern); its compiled mirror is committed at lib/. No external services or secrets are required.
